title: Margaret River: Private Full-Day Winery Tour for Two with Four-Course Lunch, Tastings & Transfers
description:
Experience the best that the Margaret River wine-producing region has to offer with a private bespoke guided tour, where you'll travel beyond the cellar door with an immersive exploration of two of the region's highly-acclaimed wineries. Begin with a guided walk through Voyager Estate's vineyards, learning about organic farming methods and unique microclimate and maritime influence distinctive of the Voyager Estate style. From here, guests are invited to taste wine straight from the barrel and gain insight into the philosophy that drives the winemaking craft. Next up, you will be guided through a selection of celebrated Margaret River varietals at the Cellar Door. Move into Voyager’s restaurant, TripAdvisor’s top-rated venue for Margaret River, for a four-course lunch created by Head Chef Santiago Fernandez and his team, with each dish inspired by the wines and celebrating pristine local produce.

Continue your exploration of earth and expression at Vasse Felix, the founding winery of the Margaret River Wine Region, with an insightful introduction to the vineyards and wine tasting. Immerse yourself in the unique history and folklore of Vasse Felix, then be enthralled by the finer details of organic viticulture and the land as you explore the region’s original vineyard, planted in 1967. You’ll uncover knowledge of the environmental elements that bring unique characters to the wines, which will reveal layers of sensory delight during your private tasting of the Vasse Felix Wine Collection,  accompanied by a small selection of gourmet bites.

title: Tranquil Mauritius Beachfront Hideaway with Ocean Views, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Dinner
description:
Embrace the warmth of the Indian Ocean's breeze on the sun-kissed shores of Mauritius, where peaceful luxury meets serene island living. On the palm-fringed shores of Balaclava Bay, this tranquil haven offers a front-row seat to lush gardens adorned with exotic trees and the azure coral-filled lagoon. Catering to every whim and desire, the InterContinental Mauritius Resort Balaclava Fort, an IHG Hotel boasts four exquisite restaurants, a stylish swim-up bar, two glittering pools and a passionate team devoted to ensuring a seamless and memorable stay. Whether you're a thrill-seeker or in search of some rest and relaxation, an array of resort activities await. Explore the island's extensive coral reefs from above in a glass-bottom boat or kayak, or below by snorkelling or learning to dive with an expert.

Come time to dine, the resort's four restaurants will be sure to satisfy. Watch meticulous chefs prepare international delights at the buffet-style Senso, crafting cuisine from Indian tandoor to Middle Eastern grills in an open kitchen. Look out at volcanic mountain that stretches next to the turquoise ocean at Segala, encompassing the culinary traditions of Spain, Italy, Greece and Turkey. At Veda, sit against a backdrop of lush tropical greenery and discover the diverse flavours of India, or be soothed by the sound of waves at the open-air Noble House while savouring modern Asian dishes. Spend days lounging poolside and cool off with a drink at the swim-up Sugar Cane beach bar, offering an extensive list of cocktails and mocktails - the perfect way to end a day of tropical bliss.

description:
Experience unmatched luxury with an escape to this tropical haven on Mauritius' picturesque coast in the spectacular Turtle Bay area. In a combination of pure relaxation and fun-for-all, The Westin Turtle Bay Resort & Spa, Mauritius offers the ultimate island retreat, with panoramic views of the Indian Ocean and countless onsite facilities and activities. Indulge in a variety of cuisines and exotic ingredients in one of five different onsite restaurants all offering a captivating tropical setting, or sit back and enjoy a smoothie or cocktail at The Retreat Bar. For those seeking tranquility, Heavenly Spa by Westin offers anything from massages to body wraps, and the resort boasts both a kids' and an adults-only pool for lounging with or without the little ones. If you're after something more active, take advantage of the resort's tennis courts, the 24-hour fitness centre, or complimentary watersports activities - there's something for everyone.

When you're ready to venture out and explore the local area, the island's white sand beaches and crystal clear waters are at your fingertips. Try sailing, water-skiing or windsurfing if you're an adventure lover, or experience some of the best diving in Turtle Bay. For something a little more relaxed, Grand Baie is just a short drive away, offering vibrant restaurants and bars, as well as more serene beaches. The area is also known as the best place to shop on the island, if you're seeking some retail therapy. For a slight change of scenery, visit Pamplemousses Botanical Garden or the Sugar Museum and Factory and learn about the island's culture and history.

Experience signature Pullman elegance with a five-star stay high above the vibrant streets of Bangkok. Escape to one of the most desirable addresses in Thailand, where a relaxing oasis awaits, complete with a stunning Exclusive Club Lounge on the hotel’s 27th floor.

Bangkok’s world-renowned attractions and hidden gems are at your fingertips. You’ll find the vibrant nightlife of Silom Road nearby, home to Patpong Night Market and Lumphini Park, and for gravity-defying, 360-degree views of the city, the Mahanakhon Skywalk is within a five-minute walk.

After busy days exploring the city, retreat to the 37th-floor Scarlett Wine Bar & Restaurant. Voted one of Thailand’s Best Restaurants in the Michelin guide, Scarlett allows you to pair near-uninterrupted rooftop panoramas with your perfectly cooked sirloin steak and a glass of fine red wine.

Sophisticated cocktails are called for at the onsite lobby bar 25 Degrees, where hungry guests can also satisfy midnight cravings at the 24-hour burger restaurant, regarded as one of Bangkok’s best burger joints. For days of pure relaxation, stretch out by the swimming pool or visit the onsite spa.
offer_address: 188 Silom Road, Bangrak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

title: Bangkok Self-Contained Sukhumvit Suites with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Drinks & Dining Credit
description:
Moments of bliss amid the bustling city of Bangkok abound at this inner-city gem. Sharing their address with three onsite restaurants and a glistening rooftop pool, these ultra-chic apartments - boasting fully equipped kitchens and open-plan study and living spaces - are ideal for business travellers and seekers of leisure alike.

In between restaurant-hopping and retail-hunting on the humming streets of Bangkok’s Watthana District, take advantage of the hotel’s steam room, sauna and landscaped garden. At nightfall, Above Eleven Rooftop Bar & Restaurant welcomes you to be part of the city's sparkling skyline while sipping handcrafted cocktails.
offer_address: 38/8 Sukhumvit Road, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

Experience a city stay like never before in this 1920’s inspired hotel as you indulge in daily buffet breakfast, access to the Club La Boutique lounge and all its benefits including nightly free-flow drinks and snacks and a dining experience during your stay.

title: Sky-High Central Bangkok Retreat with 16th-Floor Infinity Pool, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Cocktails
description:
Contemporary opulence sparkling above Si Phraya Road awaits at this sky-high haven. As the inaugural hotel in Bangkok's dusitD2 series, guests are treated to a wealth of upscale facilities that make the most of sweeping city views.

The hotel's dining spaces are built with worldly travellers in mind, offering Mexican cuisine at the poolside Bebidas, freshly baked pastries and international fare at Dusit Gourmet and rooftop cocktails, American diner favourites and after-hours fun at Mimi's. For moments of treasured tranquillity, savour skyline views in the 16th-floor infinity pool before retreating to your plush room.

dusitD2 Samyan Bangkok relishes in local connections and can arrange temple, gallery, art and food tours that sample the city's most vibrant locations. Discover the city as it was 80 years ago at the Bangkokian Museum, embrace the majesty of The Temple of the Emerald Buddha and witness street art in Talad Noi, all nearby.
offer_address: 333 Si Phraya Road, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

title: Five-Star Bangkok Riverside Oasis with Daily Breakfast & Club Access with Free-Flow Cocktail Hour
description:
Soak up the hum of one of the world’s most vibrant cities at the Chatrium Hotel Riverside Bangkok, situated on the east bank of the mighty Chao Phraya River. The ultimate base to explore the culture and history of Bangkok, the hotel has gained a five-star reputation for its luxury service and world-class amenities. Relax in the Chatrium Club Lounge, dine in one of the hotel's six excellent restaurants, enjoy a drink at one of the bars or unwind by the riverside pool as you take in gorgeous views.

Immerse yourself in the city that never sleeps, sampling a unique mix of high-end boutiques and traditional floating markets, towering skyscrapers and gilded temples, world-class dining and mouthwatering street food. Check out the city's renowned mega malls: Siam Paragon, Central World and MBK Center - a shopping haven with over 2,000 boutiques. At the end of long days of discovery, your luxurious hotel awaits, a welcome centre of calm away from the bustling Bangkok streets.
offer_address: 28 Charoen Krung Rd, Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

title: Sky-High Banyan Tree Luxury in the Heart of Bangkok with Award-Winning Rooftop Bar & Club Access
description:
Fall in love with Bangkok’s thriving CBD and enjoy a five-star stay at Banyan Tree Bangkok, a sky-high urban oasis and the perfect base to discover the city's bright lights, world-class shopping and diverse culture with absolute ease. Sip martinis at the lauded onsite rooftop Moon Bar, offering unrivalled views across the striking city skyline, and embark on a culinary journey across seven onsite restaurants offering expertly prepared dishes, from Thai classics to Japanese fare. It's effortless luxury for the discerning traveller looking to truly experience everything Bangkok has to offer.

Housed in one of Asia’s tallest buildings and ranked in the top 1% of hotels worldwide on Tripadvisor, Banyan Tree Bangkok is just a short drive away from some of Bangkok's most popular sights, including crimson Buddhist temple Wat Pathum Wanaram, Lumphini Park and Pratu Nam ferry wharf, where you can explore the city like a local via water taxi.

title: Sky-High Bangkok Sukhumvit Sanctuary with Rooftop Bar, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Free-Flow Drinks
description:
Found in the vibrant heart of Sukhumvit, this cool and contemporary escape is your home base for exploring Bangkok's energy-soaked streets. Think sleek rooms that give you a breather from the madness, but keep you close enough to dive right back in. Keeping things things laid-back but lively, Radisson Blu Plaza Bangkok is right in the heart of this diverse district's hustle.

After a day of pounding the pavement in the heat, cool off in the outdoor pool or ride the lift up to Brewski, the rooftop bar serving icy craft beers and sky-high vibes. You’ll get knockout views and a front-row seat to Bangkok’s electric skyline.

Staying in? No worries - there’s a spa for some well-earned pampering, a gym for blowing off steam and beds so comfy you’ll melt into them. When it's time to explore once more, you're minutes from Sukhumvit's mega-malls, sizzling street eats and wild markets, plus the BTS Skytrain is on your doorstep.

title: Five-Star Anantara Bangkok Riverside Jungle Luxury with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Free-Flow Cocktails & Cruise Upgrades Available
description:
Discover Bangkok from a new angle with a stay at the five-star Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort, perfectly placed on the serene banks of the Chao Phraya River. With Thailand’s shining capital on the horizon and the jungle by your side, it’s never been easier to discover Bangkok’s best - the hotel’s complimentary shuttle ferry service means you’re just a short hop from high-end shopping malls, ancient temples and vibrant marketplaces. Return to signature Anantara hospitality steeped in an old-world Siam spirit and 10 extraordinary restaurants and bars, including international teppanyaki house Benihana, historic house of tiki tipples Trader Vic’s and waterfront Longtail by the River, the perfect place to kick back and watch the world drift lazily by.

With a rotating schedule of authentic experiences, including Buddhist ceremonies, longtail boat tours, yoga workshops and city tours, Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort is brimming with fresh discoveries. Surrounded by 11 acres of lush greenery, this riverside oasis offers the rarest of Bangkok treasures - peace, privacy and undisturbed quiet. Make the most of it by lazing by the magnificent central pool or sample Anantara Spa’s massive menu of wellness treatments, ranging from Himalayan thermal salt therapy to traditional Thai massages.
offer_address: 257/1-3 Charoennakorn Road, Thonburi, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

title: Bangkok Kempinski Opulence with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Cocktails, Club Lounge Access & Wellness Experiences
description:
Discover a slice of leafy serenity in the middle of Sindhorn Village, Bangkok's upscale lifestyle complex. Kempinski is synonymous with luxury, and this is no exception, with stunning wellness facilities, lavishly spacious rooms and suites and culinary creations worth writing home about. Six exquisite restaurants and bars are guaranteed to set your tastebuds into a frenzy - whether it's classic cocktails at Firefly Bar or Japanese cuisine at Ki Izakaya, delicate pastries from the onsite delicatessen or delicious Thai and Levantine flavours at Flourish.

Wellness is at the forefront, with an entire floor dedicated to Sindhorn Wellness by Resense, home to an infinity pool with stunning views of the sunlit city, a luxury day spa with hydrotherapy baths and a fitness centre. When you're not making good use of Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok's facilities, head out to explore the quiet, leafy grounds of the nearby Lumphini Park. This botanical oasis is the perfect place to soak in the skyline before strolling to Velaa Sindhorn Village for dinner, shopping and drinks.
offer_address: 80 Soi Ton Son, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, 10330, Bangkok, Thailand

description:
Experience the best Bangkok has to offer at the multiple award-winning five-star Tower Club at Lebua, home to the two-Michelin-star restaurant, Mezzaluna, the iconic rooftop bar Sky Bar, and the world's tallest gin, caviar and vodka bar.

Named the World's Leading Luxury Suites Hotel and Asia’s Leading Luxury All Suite Hotel at the World Travel Awards 2021, the hotel also has an enviable position between the 51st and the 59th floors of State Tower - Thailand’s third tallest building. Facilities include an open-air swimming pool with soaring views over the City of Angels, while a fully-equipped gym is the perfect place to maintain your workout regime. When you’re ready to be treated like royalty, head Café Mozu (on the M floor) and the outdoor pool area to enjoy Tower Club Lounge perks including daily dining, and free-flowing drinks every day (6am - 6pm). If you can drag yourself away, you're only a 15-minute drive to some of Bangkok’s must-see sights, including Wat Arun riverside temple, the buzzing Chatuchak Weekend Market, and the Royal Grand Palace.

title: Luxurious Central Bangkok Oasis with Daily Executive Lounge Access, Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
description:
Discover a luxury hotel with an iconic design in an unrivalled location when you stay at Anantara Siam Bangkok Hotel. Expect lavish decor, from crystal-chandeliered ceilings to hand-painted silk murals and impeccably kept gardens. High-end facilities include 10 exquisite restaurants, a tranquil day spa, swimming pool, hair salon, barber shop, health centre, yoga studio and kids' club. With some of Bangkok's best restaurants, bars and shopping malls just a short stroll away, plus access to the nearby BTS Skytrain connecting you to over 60 stations, a stay at Anantara Siam Bangkok Hotel places you at the centre of all the action.

Take your pick from sun-drenched guestrooms and lavish suites, and take refuge from the city's buzzing energy in your own private oasis. When you're ready to leave the comfort of your stylishly appointed room, spend your days basking in the Thai sun by the outdoor pool, indulging in an onsite cooking class at Spice Spoons or recharging with an opulent treatment at Anantara Spa.
offer_address: 155 Ratchadamri Road, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

You’ll feel the pulse of one of the liveliest cities in the world with a high-end urban stopover that includes one cocktail each at Moon Bar and exclusive VIP access to the Club Lounge with daily buffet breakfast, nightly happy hour, daily free-flow beer, coffee, tea and snacks, daily laundry or clothes pressing and more. title: Bangkok City Sanctuary in the Heart of Siam with Rooftop Pool, Club Access & Nightly Free-Flow Cocktails
description:
Experience unrivalled luxury at Chatrium Grand Bangkok, a five-star property that exudes charm and character in the heart of one of the world's most vibrant cities. The ultimate base to explore the culture and history of the Thai capital, the hotel (one of the latest additions to the city) has gained a glowing reputation for its renowned service and world-class amenities. Chatrium Grand Bangkok offers guests an unrivalled central position in the heart of the Siam business district, right near the Siam Center shopping mall. Enjoy a breezy walk to many of Bangkok's countless delights, including The Grand Palace, Lumphini Park and the Saket Temple.

After days of discovery, return to Chatrium Grand Bangkok's perfect fusion of upscale elegance and modern comforts. The hotel’s exquisite dining offerings promise brilliance in abundance - delight with contemporary cuisine in the lively Savio restaurant, savour all-you-can-eat afternoon tea in the refined Lobby Lounge or drink in spectacular city views from the light-filled Flow pool lounge. Round out the day with a tranquil spa treatment at the soothing THANN wellness sanctuary or with a dip in the oasis-style pool.

title: Bangkok Blue Elephant Thai Cooking Class with Lunch & Take-Home Gift
description:
Master the art of Thai cuisine with a half-day cooking class at Blue Elephant Cooking School Bangkok. Follow your expert chef as they guide you step-by-step through four mouthwatering, authentic Thai dishes to create your own four-course meal comprised of a starter, soup, main dish and an accompanying dish. 

Whether you’re a fan of fresh papaya salad, a fragrant green curry with melt-in-your-mouth chicken, silky coconut milk soup with prawns or a classic Pad Thai, you’ll be dealt the tools and skills to recreate these globally loved dishes at home. If you choose a morning class, you’ll gather local ingredients fresh from the market soon after you arrive. Then, prepare to cook up a storm and perfect culinary techniques unique to Thai cuisine. The best part? You can enjoy the fruits of your labour with a lunchtime feast.
offer_address: BTS station, 233 S Sathon Rd, Yan Nawa Sathon, Surasak, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

title: Ultra-Luxe Spacious Suites in the Heart of Bangkok with Daily Breakfast & Lounge Access
description:

Beautifully appointed suites feature spacious living areas, kitchen facilities and plush bedding. After a shopping spree at Siam Square - about a 20-minute stroll away -  escape the heat with a plunge in the outdoor pool. Feel your stresses soak away in the steam room and sauna or treat yourself at the hotel's renowned Italian restaurant, No.43 Italian Bistro.

The city's top attractions are within easy reach; picturesque Lumphini Park is around a 15-minute walk, while the BTS subway network is a convenient five-minute stroll from your front door. Fancy a big night on the town? Hop in a taxi, and in less than 20 minutes you'll be among the vibrant bars and restaurants of Khao San Road.
offer_address: 43 Soi Langsuan, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan District, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

description: Make Mövenpick BDMS Wellness Resort Bangkok your inner-city oasis in Thailand’s vibrant capital. description:
Experience unmatched luxury at this urban oasis, offering an exceptional blend of first-class service, exceptional dining and spectacular views over Bangkok. From the moment you step inside, you’ll be enveloped in elegance - spend your days lazing by the rooftop infinity pool and bar, where panoramic views of the city skyline set the perfect scene, or head to VIE Spa to experience Thai wellness at its absolute finest.

The dining at VIE Hotel Bangkok - MGallery is unrivalled. Embark on a culinary oddyssey at house of refined French cuisine Signature (one Michelin star), exceptional omakase spot YTSB - Yellow Tail Sushi Bar or head to La VIE Bistronomy for fiery Thai flavours and beloved international classics.

Venture beyond the hotel to explore Bangkok’s vibrant cultural gems, from the historic Grand Palace to the peaceful Lumphini Park. After a day of discovery, return to the hotel and unwind at the chic Piano Bar, sipping handcrafted cocktails and enjoying delicious canapes before your night begins.

offer_address: 117 39 40, Phaya Thai Road, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

title: Sophisticated Five-Star SO/ Bangkok Stay with Club Signature Access & Nightly Free-Flow Cocktails
description:
Spoil your senses with a sublime stay at SO/ Bangkok - an outrageously fashionable sanctuary located in Bangkok's lively entertainment district. Part of the sophisticated, fashion-led SO/ Hotels & Resorts, this tranquil hideaway radiates contemporary cool and has mastered the art of theatricality. Designed by legendary couturier Christian Lacroix, the hotel oozes French elegance, with fantasy and folklore elements seamlessly integrated throughout, from modernist retrofitted furniture and eclectic wallpapers to playful staff uniforms.

Between bouts of exploring the city, Club Signature is the perfect spot to indulge in spectacular city views. title: Sophisticated Bangkok Escape with Daily Breakfast, Daily Cocktails & Onsite Spa
description:
Discover five-star luxury at one of Bangkok's most lavish hotels, surrounded by gilded temples, floating markets, and world-class dining in Thailand's capital. With architecture inspired by the riverside location, expect a mix of traditional Thai design with modern details and spectacular facilities.

Delight in the fusion of fine art and modern Australian cuisine at Brisbane’s GOMA Restaurant, one of Gourmet Traveller's Top 10 Queensland Restaurants in 2022 and the recipient of an Australian Good Food Guide 2022 Chef Hat Award. A strong focus on local ingredients and cutting-edge techniques has made the restaurant as ambitious and captivating as the gallery it calls home. Experience the magic yourself with The Great Queensland Getaway, a chef's banquet of five shared and individual courses, each showcasing the magnificence of Queensland's regional produce. Delight in three matched wines (half pour) throughout your meal, each glass celebrating a unique Australian terroir. Afterwards, be sure to explore the acclaimed Gallery of Modern Art for a day you'll never forget (admission for ticketed exhibitions is not included).

Begin your epicurean adventure with a complimentary glass of prosecco on arrival and indulge in the first course of rosemary sourdough and house-cultured malt butter. Follow with oysters topped with smoked herring roe and soured cream before continuing to the third course of duck leg braised in barbecue plum hoisin sauce. The fourth course might be the best of all: succulent Borrowdale pork collar served with Madeira sauce and apple remoulade. Finish with a dessert of lemon meringue ice cream and luxurious Uji matcha.

title: Tasmania Vineyard Cabin Escape just 40 Minutes from Hobart
description:
If your idea of pure bliss is rolling hills covered in grapevines that change colour with the season, The Picker’s Hut at Invercarron - a luxury cabin dramatically perched above the Jordan Valley in southern Tasmania - eagerly awaits. It might feel worlds apart from real life, but this luxury countryside stay is just a 40-minute drive from Hobart's unmissable attractions. Enjoy exclusive use of the property so you can come and go as you wish.

Once built to house and train soldiers before World War II, this historic hut has found its new home on a working Merino sheep farm and vineyard, Invercarron, and still retains the original foundations and floorboards to honour the building's storied past. A variety of water activities means you can make the most of your time here: from kayaking to windsurfing, paddle boarding, jet skiing, diving and snorkelling - take your pick. - Each day is a gourmet affair with à la carte breakfast at Wine Street Restaurant
- Each evening, enjoy a glass of beer or wine at Churchill's Champagne Bar
- Indulge with NZ$50 dining credit to be used at Wine Street Restaurant
- Relax until the last moment with guaranteed 11am late checkout

- Exploring is made easy thanks to complimentary onsite self-parking for one vehicle per stay

**This deal has NO peak surcharges:** Travel any time for the same great price.

Perched on the edge of Anse Vata Bay, the resort boasts an unbeatable view of the world’s largest lagoon - recognised by UNESCO - along with effortless access to the surrounding pristine beaches. The influences of the French territory's background are carefully interwoven throughout the resort, from the eclectic art pieces adorning the walls to the flavours on offer at the onsite eateries - Le Sextant promises seafood favourites alongside beachfront views, while Le Faré's al fresco setting and lounge-style seating make it the perfect place to unwind with a cocktail in hand.

If you can pull yourself away from your luxurious accommodation, venture out to discover bustling Nouméa, taking in its unique mix of South Pacific beauty and European charm for yourself. High-end shopping awaits at Sebastopol Street and museums, art galleries, theatres and cinemas can be found around every corner. Further afield, hike up the majestic Mont-Dore for awe-inspiring panoramic views of the island. Return to the resort and enjoy a breather at the relaxing Deep Nature Spa, take a refreshing dip in the outdoor, palm-fringed swimming pool or explore the enormous double-barrier coral reef - the second longest in the world, outdone only by Australia's Great Barrier Reef.

title: Perth: The Boatshed Restaurant Five-Course Dinner Experience for Two with Fresh Seafood & Paired Wines
description:
The Boatshed Restaurant invites you to delight in the perfect pairing of Margaret River wine and modern Australian dining. Introduce yourself to Perth’s fine dining scene as nouvelle cuisine is delivered with the care, warmth and attention to detail only a family-owned restaurant can provide. Bask in 180-degree views of the Swan River and Kings Park before being guided through a dazzling, five-course tour de force showcasing the finest fresh seafood. And you won't go thirsty - the experience is paired with four incredible wines from the internationally acclaimed Margaret River region.

To start, you will be presented with an hors d'oeuvre of black truffle butter and baguette. The first course will follow, with Tasmanian ocean trout tartare served with caviar and Australian finger lime paired with a strawberry-touched Skuttlebut rosé. Shark Bay scallops and Catalan chorizo meet wonderfully in the second course, paired with a refreshing Stella Bella Semillon Sauvignon Blanc. The third course presents an impossible choice: either grilled barramundi, Sicilian caponata, romanesco, purple potato or slow-cooked lamb shank with polenta, nduja croquette and broccolini. This is paired with a glass of either the sublime Stella Bella Chardonnay or the bright, charming Stella Bella Cabernet Merlot. Finally, finish with an elderflower crème brulée with mixed berry compote paired with the Stella Bella Pink Moscato, lovingly crafted from the finest Muscat Rose à Petits Grains in the heart of the Margaret River region.

Luxe All-Inclusive Upgrades also include an open minibar replenished daily with Twenty Third Street spirits, wine, beer, champagne and more, plus the sunset cruise and a private six-hour guided wetland and wildlife safari cruise with morning tea, gourmet 'bushtucker' lunch and refreshments.

This heritage property was built in 1835 as one of the first homesteads established in Tasmania. If you’re dreaming of Greek paradise, with golden sands and turquoise waters, the elegant Cape Sounio Grecotel Boutique Resort is for you. Located in Sounio, this idyllic part of the world is best known as the home of the Temple of Poseidon, one of the major monuments of the Golden Age of Athens. Grab glimpses of this iconic cultural landmark from your perfectly placed accommodation, all minimalistically furnished in a terracotta palette that seamlessly merge into the unspoiled landscape. Take a moment to appreciate the crystal-clear Aegean Sea next to gentle crescsent-shaped beaches, savour authentic Greek food and international cuisine at the onsite gourmet restaurants, or celebrate the Full Moon with a vibrant beach party.

Spend your days relaxing on the resort’s two private beaches, go sailing, explore the majestic site of the Temple of Poseidon, or ask for walking routes available through the picturesque Sounio National Park. With a refreshing mix of Jain and Marwari traditions and Bengali culture, Bari Kothi Azimganj embraces every guest like their own kin and forges everlasting bonds.

Decadent details make each room more than worthy of their namesake deity, with jewelled tones, natural materials and contemporary comforts sitting alongside eco-friendly features and beautifully preserved remnants of the ancient caves they are housed in. They form the perfect base for exploring what Cappadocia has to offer, best organised by the on-site concierge. From horse riding to hot air ballooning, off-road driving to a photography tour, there are plenty of ways to explore the UNESCO-listed sites just outside your front door. At the end of all your adventuring, a fine-dining feast awaits at The Plum Restaurant, where a perfectly placed sun terrace features jaw-dropping views of both the action outside and the property’s private vineyard. The ultra-seasonal Mediterranean menu celebrates farm-fresh local ingredients, giving you a taste of Turkey with every bite.

**Luxury Escapes inclusions (select nights)**

- Admire Cappadocia’s skyline while enjoying **daily à la carte breakfast** at The Plum Restaurant
- Start your stay with a **welcome glass of champagne**

The rolling French countryside is a treasure trove of medieval architecture, sun-kissed vineyards and sensational food - enjoy the spoils of this picturesque rural region with a stay at Maison Doucet, an elegant hideaway in the charming village of Charolles. The hotel's onsite restaurant, Bistrot du Quai, has earned a Michelin star, with Chef Frédéric Doucet creating a menu full of explosive flavours and traditional dishes using fresh ingredients carefully selected from local producers. You'll also enjoy incredible facilities, including an outdoor heated swimming pool, a six-seat Jacuzzi and a blissful day spa.

During your stay, you'll have the wonders of France's incomparable Burgundy region at your fingertips. Charolles has been coined 'the Venice of the Charolais region' thanks to its abundance of canals crisscrossing the village. Wander the footbridges, stop in at a local bistro for a bite to eat and a tipple of the finest local drop, and zip from vineyard to vineyard to see where it's all made. It would be remiss of you not to pour yourself a glass or two of chardonnay or pinot noir, the region's specialty.

description:

You're in the perfect position to explore the rugged green beauty of the Emerald Isle, including the Ring of Kerry, Killarney National Park, numerous boutiques, cafés, shops and art galleries and half a dozen championship golf courses.

Spectacular surroundings and a rich, layered history bring this corner of Ireland to life in a way that must be experienced to be believed. Occupying space on the grounds of the 800-year-old Ashford Castle, The Lodge immediately transports you to the heart of Ireland as you bask in the shadows of this grand structure, teeming with national significance and a storied past. Each room has been uniquely crafted so no two stays are the same, and you will feel instantly welcomed by the inviting, country house atmosphere. Eye-catching artworks adorn the walls and ornate furnishings matched with modern touches contribute to unrivalled amounts of character.

The expansive grounds that surround the lodge make for the perfect spot to indulge in a range of activities. From gentle walks to a round of golf on the perfectly manicured nine-hole green, there is no shortage of ways to soak up the magnificent scenery while learning about Ireland’s west coast. Outside the estate, the varied delights of County Mayo await: take a pilgrimage to the mountain chapel of Croagh Patrick, visit the 18th-century residence and amusement park at Westport House, take in the scenery at Keem Bay or marvel at the wild beauty of Ballycroy National Park.

Galway is renowned for its fascinating attractions, including the Spanish Arch, Eyre Square and surrounding woodland. When you’re not spending time exploring the natural wonders that frame the city, spoil yourself with a revitalising treatment at Galway’s only five-star spa, ESPA at the g. Enjoy afternoon tea and incredible cocktails at the hotel's enchanting Signature Lounges or visit the stunning 2 AA Rosette-wining Restaurant for mouthwatering local delicacies.

Continuing this tradition, R Hotel Geelong also offers guests an unrivalled location - a short walk from Eastern Beach and Austin Park. Spend your days wandering along the picturesque waterfront, discovering culinary hidden gems, ride the 19th-century hand-carved carousel or the Giant Sky Wheel, check out the interactive National Wool Museum and Geelong Gallery, or enjoy a scenic road trip to the You Yangs Regional Park. description:

Housed in a tastefully restored townhouse that once belonged to Baron Olivier Reylof, this boutique hotel seamlessly blends old-world glamour and modern touches for an unforgettable escape in this charming Belgian city. Heritage details such as majestic staircases, roaring fireplaces, high ceilings and marble floors sit side by side with contemporary art installations, a luxurious spa and a top-of-the-range gym in Baron Reylof’s former carriage house.

Surrounded by some of the city’s best restaurants, cafés and sights, the hotel places you in a strategic position to explore the magic of Ghent. Top attractions within walking distance include the 10th-century Gravensteen Castle, colourful Graffiti Street, Design Museum Gent and the ornate City Hall. When you’re ready to unwind, Pillows Grand Boutique Hotel Reylof’s luxurious facilities will pamper you in every way. From the sophisticated restaurant LOF, headed by Michelin-starred Chef Ron Blaauw and serving up local specialties with a modern twist, to the cosy rooms fitted with original artworks and plush beds, you’ll have plenty of reasons to feel right at home in this elegant hotel.

The proud owners have curated a welcoming environment that ensures an idyllic retreat for visitors seeking a peaceful weekend or a romantic escape.

Stroll through the extensive gardens dotted with orchards and cherry trees or mingle with new friends in the communal lounge and dining rooms. Enjoy homecooked fare in the fabulous kitchen or ask the owners for their best local recommendations. When you want to explore further, venture down the road to stunning Motunau Beach, visit Hamner Spring Thermal Pools & Spa, located only an hour away, or take a road trip to Gore Bay and Cathedral Cliffs to admire the naturally dramatic coastline.

Each of the 57 charming rooms redefines a stylish and relaxed country-house ambience, with stunning mountain and garden panoramas sure to delight even the most seasoned ski-lovers. After days navigating the refreshingly uncrowded slopes or luscuous mountain trails, enjoy fireside dining at a selection of restaurants and bars directly connected to The Vale Rusutsu at Base Camp - a comprehensive retail, dining and entertainment hub.

Thoughtfully designed to achieve the total comfort of all of its guests, The Vale Rusutsu is an all-season, all-mountain masterpiece that is all yours. Contemporary comforts abound in both private and public areas, including The Bridge Bar & Bistro, where Thai and Western delights are served from sun-up to well past sundown. While each room faces the river, the best spot for water-gazing is the infinity pool, complete with comfortable sunbeds. When the time comes to explore further afield, hop on a complimentary bicycle for an afternoon well spent. Ranked among the top 1% of properties worldwide on Tripadvisor, this hotel is a tranquil Thai luxury at its finest.

**Luxury Escapes inclusions:**

- Start each morning with **daily breakfast** at The Bridge Bar & Bistro
- Embrace that holiday feeling with a refreshing **welcome cocktail**
- Head to The Bridge Bar & Bistro for one **two-course lunch or dinner** (for stays of 2+ nights)
- Float into pure peacefulness with a **30-minute massage per adult** (for stays of 3+ nights)

**Overwater River Upgrade:** Spend your days perched directly over the Kwai Noi River, lounging on your outdoor mesh daybed, exploring the water by kayak or taking in the view from your private rooftop when you upgrade to an XFloat Luxe Cabin.

Spend your days riding horses through gorges, cruising the Bullo river, looking out for wildlife and admiring the station from above with a helicopter ride. Swim in billabongs, picnic by waterfalls and learn more about the ancient Miriuwung-Gajerrong culture by exploring traditional rock art sites. Don't miss the exclusive helicopter touring experience to Victoria River Lookout. Perched high on a rocky outcrop, overlooking Victoria River, awe-inspiring doesn’t do this location justice. Wake early and experience it at sunrise or spend a romantic evening admiring the view at sunset with a platter and drinks.

After adventurous days, retire to your purpose-built, air-conditioned ensuite room, laze by the homestead pool, or take your pick of hammocks among the palm trees. Meals are a communal affair - breakfast is served on the veranda and dinners celebrate the bevvy of beautiful ingredients found on the station, including organic prime beef and barramundi (that you may have even caught yourself!). Lunch is incorporated into your daily activity, with fresh treats packed by the team.

title: Five-Star Lisbon Luxury with High-End Day Spa
description:

The hotel epitomises style and luxury: public spaces are flooded with natural light, surfaces are laid with fresh flowers and chandeliers glitter. The onsite restaurant Erva serves up some of the city’s best local food. Meanwhile, Soul Garden is the go-to evening spot where you can chill out on a wooden cabana with a handcrafted cocktail in hand, listening to live music or DJ sets. When you need to soothe mind, body and soul, THE SPA with its heated jacuzzi, sauna and steam room awaits to pamper you.

You’ll be well placed to discover Lisbon’s iconic sites from your stylish hotel base. Castelo de Sao Jorge, Alfama and Jerónimos Monastery are all within a 15-minute drive, while Lisbon Zoo and Águas Livres Aqueduct are also closeby. Don’t miss out on a ride aboard the 28E tram, a bucket-list experience for most visitors. The yellow, old-fashioned tram travels from Praça Martim Moniz to Campo de Ourique, skimming the city's famous steep hills.

title: Historic Lisbon Mansion Stay with River-View Pool

Located on Colina de Santana, in the heart of Lisbon, this beautiful hotel puts you high atop one of Lisbon's seven hills, steps from the city's oldest lift (a welcome option for tired feet) and a short walk from the Portuguese capital's top attractions. The peaceful Jardim do Torel park and bustling Rossio square can be reached within minutes, and the hotel's friendly staff are always on hand to provide maps and recommendations for further exploration.

Torel Palace's river-view pool takes advantage of its hillside position, inviting guests to cool off while enjoying sweeping views across Lisbon's burnt orange rooftops and the Tagus River. Spend evenings in the dimly lit comfort of Terraço 23, a unique spot for signature cocktails, pre-dinner drinks, light tapas bites, salads and burgers. At the end of each day, your boutique hotel room awaits, blending the opulence of the past with modern comforts.

title: Five-Star Montenegro Waterfront Escape with Private Beach Overlooking the Adriatic Sea
description:
Strike the perfect balance between crystal-clear Adriatic waters, Mediterranean-inspired culture and nearly year-round sunshine in Montenegro at the five-star boutique Chedi Luštica Bay. Stretched along the waterfront of Luštica Bay, this luxury hotel is cradled by the tranquil embrace of the recently built Trašte Bay - where the striking Montenegrin coast meets the azure Adriatic Sea. Here, you will find some of the country's best restaurants and boutiques, and a sublime, right-off-the-yacht marina.

Each of the 111 designer rooms redefines breezy-chic and reflects Chedi’s maritime environment, drawing on architecture from the local villages, a subdued palette of aquamarine, grey and white, and views of the surrounding water and/or mountains. Channelling a contemporary look, the hotel's luxurious interiors are spacious, stylish and sunlit.

During your stay, choose to relish the delights of refined, regional cuisine at The Restaurant or dine on an alfresco lunch at The Spot. Equally mesmerising is The Rok, a dramatic bar carved into a natural rock on the soft sands of The Chedi's incredible private beach. Should the sun be shining, the heated outdoor infinity pool that cascades across three levels is the perfect place to watch the world go by, while The Spa, with a gym and four calming treatment rooms, will relieve stress and restore strength. While leaving the hotel is optional, there’s more to explore further afield - from wine and olive oil tastings to visiting the medieval town of Kotor, just 20 minutes’ drive away.

**Luxury Escapes inclusions (select packages)**

- **Daily buffet breakfast** of fresh fruit, juices, pastries, made-to-order eggs, pancakes and waffles at The Restaurant
- Toast your coastal escape in style with a **welcome drink** served on arrival in the lobby
- Be greeted with a **fresh fruit platter**
- Indulge with **EUR20 dining credit** per package for onsite restaurants and bars (for stays of 3+ nights)
- Sink into a world of relaxation with a **50-minute Asian-inspired massage per person** at the award-winning spa (for stays of 7+ nights)

**Penthouse upgrade available**: Choose to stretch out in the largest accommodation at The Chedi Luštica Bay in a Luštica Bay Penthouse - with two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a spacious living area.

title: Iconic Five-Star Heritage-Listed Melbourne Stay

With previous guests ranging from English and Hollywood royalty to former Australian prime ministers, this five-star, heritage-listed property is world-renowned for its original Victoriana décor and as the home of Australia’s longest continual afternoon tea service. Sitting at the top of Spring Street, in Melbourne’s CBD, this grand hotel couldn’t be closer to the action - it’s opposite Parliament House and surrounded by some of the city’s best-known bars and restaurants. Built in 1883, The Hotel Windsor retains its heritage charm but, thanks to a few updates, includes all the modern amenities of a five-star hotel. Luxurious rooms and suites feature marble bathrooms and generous furnishings that encourage total relaxation. Dining onsite is decadent, with afternoon tea offered in the classic dining room, and lunch and dinner inspired by classic English pub fare served in the cosy Cricketers Bar. The hotel also offers access to coveted dining destinations - modern Southeast Asian restaurant SUNDA and contemporary Australian fine dining restaurant ARU are both within the hotel's hospitality group and just a short walk away. Taste fine-dining flavours from all over the world in the dramatic chandelier-lit restaurant, or head to the beachfront for a seafood feast. Alternatively, dine under the desert stars at the seasonal Arabian Courtyard, indulging in a buffet of classic Middle Eastern favourites.

Poised on Oamaru’s South Hill, overlooking the Pacific on one side and jaw-droppingly beautiful mountains on the other, the house has been awarded historic status.

In keeping with the lodge's past, each of the five guest rooms is individually decorated with striking antiques and charming furnishings to ensure an enchanting stay. During the day, visit the endangered, yellow-eyed penguin colony at Bushy Beach, just a five-minute drive away. Don’t miss a visit to Steampunk HQ, a quirky gallery filled with sci-fi and steam-powered technology-inspired pieces and visit Oamaru Public Gardens - among the country’s oldest gardens. The Forrester Gallery and Waitaki Museum are also worth a visit, showcasing artefacts dating to the earliest days of Māori settlement. Officially opened by the King of Thailand and boasting panoramic views of the dazzling, deep-blue Gulf of Thailand, the resort offers opulence fit for a monarch. Be enchanted by the resort’s palm-fringed oceanfront pool, exquisite restaurants, pristine private beach and rejuvenating onsite spa. At the end of each day, your accommodation awaits to envelop you in jacuzzi suite luxury.

When you’re ready to explore, Pattaya offers a wealth of options. Take a ferry to the magazine-perfect Koh Larn island for a tropical adventure you’ll never forget, or make the trek to the impressively intricate Sanctuary of Truth, carved in the image of hundreds of traditional deities. Those looking to dip a toe into Thailand's dazzling nightlife will be enthralled by the city's endless bars, pubs and eateries.

description:

Contemporary elegance and thoughtful design are evident throughout the 59 boutique villas dotted across the resort, with each boasting a private pool, fully equipped kitchen and an outdoor terrace; allowing you to relax and unwind in unparalleled seclusion.

title: Opulent Designer Thai Pool Villa Escape with Daily Breakfast
description:
Leave the world behind for an ultra-luxe Thai villa escape at MASON, Pattaya, a romantic five-star retreat nestled by the golden sands of Na Jomtien. This charming town on the coast of Thailand lies just 3km south of Pattaya and a two-hour drive from bustling Bangkok. Here, days can be spent lazing on the seemingly endless stretch of beach, getting a dose of culture at Buddha Mountain in Pattaya, home to the largest engraved image of Buddha in the world, or exploring the stunning Wat Phra Yai Temple across the water.

You may never want to venture far from your stunning designer resort, built in 2019 and a relative newcomer to the area. MASON, Pattaya's iconic Sky Pool beckons for a sunset dip, while the spa offers holistic treatments and the onsite bars and restaurants are always happy to whip up a delicious meal or handcrafted cocktail. Your private villa is the cherry on top, with an ultra-modern glass design, private saltwater pool, jacuzzi and luxe bathroom with oversized bathtub.

- Wake up to **daily breakfast** at Zila Street Bistro & Bar, serving fresh, locally sourced ingredients with panoramic views of Pattaya Bay

- Head to the Beachside Bar for **one daily cocktail, beer or smoothie per adult** (for stays of 3+ nights)
- Choose between a Thai or Western **three-course set-menu dinner** at Zila Street Bistro & Bar (for stays of 3+ nights)

description:

Find yourself moments from unmissable cultural attractions, including the stunning indigo-blue facade of Cheong Fatt Tze mansion and the ornate Kek Lok Si temple, both located within a 15-minute walk. Stroll the vibrant streets, keeping your eyes peeled for Penang's famous street art, or escape the heat atop Penang Hill, where the climate is consistently cooler and breathtaking views await.

Boasting an elegant collection of contemporary rooms that embrace the building's historical character, The Edison invites you to discover the enchanting story behind its opulent past while relishing engaging service and modern amenities. Experience timeless elegance in The Lounge, an intimate restaurant complete with a library that invites guests to unwind with epicurean delights. The resort also boasts a gymnasium, a delightful garden, two swimming pools, a whirlpool, five delicious restaurants, a turtle sanctuary, three tennis courts and a nine-hole golf course.

When you're not busy enjoying resort days, head out to vibrant Penang and discover the region’s immense natural beauty. The city’s famous Batu Ferringhi Night Market and the gargantuan Adventure Zone facility are only a few minutes away by foot, or grab a paperback and some sun on Batu Ferringhi Beach's golden sands.

Apotek Hotel by Keahotels' foundation was built in 1917 and designed by Iceland’s former State Architect Guðjón Samúelsson, who was also responsible for the National Theatre building and Hallgrímskirkja. It housed the Reykjavik Apothecary (Reykjavíkurapotek) from 1930 to 1999 but has now been lovingly restored, balancing original Art Nouveau features with all the modern amenities you’d expect of a luxury hotel. All 45 rooms and suites are fitted with neutral tones and feature views of the surrounding cityscape - the perfect antidote after busy days exploring what Reykjavik has to offer. Boasting 300 days of sunshine a year, unimaginable history and traditional sandstone buildings and bastions, Malta packs a whole lot of incredible culture into its small archipelago. Explore its hilltop towns, historic seaports, elegant fishing villages and pristine beaches with a stay in one of Malta’s most impressive hotels, an iconic landmark transformed into an international retreat by acclaimed architect Edwin Mintoff.

description:

Having opened its doors over 40 years ago, with luxe renovations since then, it sets the standard for five-star living and time-honoured hospitality. Standing proudly on Namsan Mountain and surrounded by cascading traditional Korean buildings, the statuesque hotel sits among 23 acres of private wooded parkland and looks over Seoul’s commercial district. A must-visit property, The Shilla Seoul maintains a unique position as the first South Korean five-star hotel on the annual Forbes Travel Guide from 2019 through 2022.

While it may be the oldest luxury accommodation in the sprawling city, The Shilla Seoul is still as fresh as its younger counterparts, with world-class rooms and facilities. Spend your days rubbing shoulders with Seoul’s elite on the third-floor Urban Island, where heated pools, jacuzzis, cabanas and heated sunbeds sit among a rooftop garden. Should the weather turn,  visit Arcade, a 20-shop luxury mall with the likes of Hermès and Issey Miyake. However you spend your day, it should end at one of the hotel’s five restaurants. The top-floor La Yeon is the first Korean restaurant to earn two Michelin stars, while Palsun’s high-end Chinese has captured the hearts of locals, making it one of the most popular regional spots in the city.

Step back in time to discover Scottish countryside elegance and golfing history with an escape to The Rusacks St Andrews. Occupying an iconic 1800s building, the putter's playground is steeped in history, home to the world's oldest 18-hole course. Overlooking the picturesque town of St Andrews - and just a stone’s throw from Old Tom Morris’s famous Old Course Links - it’s a monument to golf and its founders, as well as a luxurious base for explorers of the seaside town, sitting just steps from the ocean. Don't love golf? Leave fans of the great game to drive their way down the green while you take in the impressive architecture of St Andrews Cathedral and St Andrews Castle, or visit the historic St Andrews University, known for educating world leaders and royals alike.

Tipping its hat to its iconic location and history, this elegant escape is a masterclass in high-end country comforts, with grand open fireplaces, lofty ceilings, stone walls and embossed ceilings. Three restaurants and bars mean there's always something to delight, but the rooftop destination restaurant, 18, is the piece de resistance, offering open-flame cooking with a side of panoramic views over the Old Course and West Sands Beach. Pop by for a drink or sign up for a feast of Scottish oysters, beef, game and seafood. The light-filled The Bridge looks after all your culinary needs from dawn to dusk, with refined takes on full Scottish breakfasts and afternoon tea. Venturing onto the immaculate 18-hole golf course is a must for fans, but there are also countless other activities to entertain, from country sports to trail bike paths and beach activities.

Savour bistro-style meals at THE ENCLAVE, watch expert mixologists craft premium cocktails at THE PAVILION and get your daily caffeine fix from FRESH cafe.

title: Five-Star Northern Italy Boutique City Escape in Former Royal Residence
description:
Live like royalty in the heart of Turin with a stay at the five-star Principi di Piemonte, ranked within the top 10% of properties on Tripadvisor. A former residence of the Italian royal family, the restored hotel remains one of the city’s architectural gems, combining contemporary comforts within a 1930s rationalist-style building.

Just steps from the iconic boutiques of Via Roma and a five-minute walk from Porta Nuova train station, it couldn’t be better placed for exploring Turin on foot. Although, there’s plenty to delight before hitting the city’s cobblestone laneways - start in the basement of the hotel where you'll find one of the city’s finest wellness centres, with a spacious steam room, sauna, and whirlpool tub. Dine on fine Italian cuisine in the intimate onsite Casa Savoia restaurant, or sip on a fine wine on the panoramic terrace, complete with views over the city centre.
offer_address: Via Piero Gobetti, 15, 10123 Torino TO, Italy

title: Italy Turin Modern Hideaway Just 15 Minutes from the City Centre
description: Be enchanted by the magic of northern Italy when you stay at Holiday Inn Turin - Corso Francia, an IHG Hotel. This is the ideal base for exploring the tree-lined streets of Turin; a place to return to after afternoons trawling the countless museums, medieval churches and restaurants. Kickstart your day with a fresh coffee in the hotel's lobby, and enjoy traditional Italian fare with a modern twist at the onsite restaurant Fermata Venchi.
offer_opportunity_name: Holiday Inn Turin-Corso Francia - IHG LPP
location_description: Holiday Inn Turin - Corso Francia, an IHG Hotel

title: Stylish Canberra Stay 5 Minutes from City Centre with Onsite Greek Restaurant
description:
Experience the  sophistication of Canberra with a stay at this stylish hotel, located in the leafy suburb of Turner, just five minutes from the city centre. Find yourself just a short stroll from the city's vibrant dining and shopping precincts, or savour culinary delights at the onsite restaurant, Podilato, serving up traditional Greek cuisine with a modern twist.

With the Australian War Memorial, National Gallery of Australia and Parliament House all within easy reach, this hotel is the perfect base for you to explore Canberra and return to your home-away-from-home with all necessary comforts.

title: Tuscany Five-Star Oceanfront Luxury with Onsite Beach Club
description:
Soak up the postcard-perfect views of Tuscany's coastline at the five-star Baglioni Resort Cala del Porto, part of the prestigious The Leading Hotels of the World collection. Overlooking the yacht-lined Punta Ala Marina, this exceptional resort invites lazy days of waterfront relaxation. Visit the pebbled cove at Cala Martina, hike up to the Castello di Punta Ala or ask the friendly staff for help planning an excursion, from a yacht trip to Elba Island to a swing on the golf course or an exciting Vespa tour.

The onsite La Spiaggia Beach Club is an oasis of waterfront luxury, where the Tuscan Sea unfurls before you and shaded sunbeds beckon. When hunger strikes, visit La Spiaggia Restaurant or Belvedere Restaurant for a refined culinary experience or hit the bar for a cocktail and snacks. The Kids' Club is on hand to take care of little ones while you make the most of the onsite wellness facilities, including a spa offering Natura Bissè treatments.
offer_opportunity_name: Baglioni Resort Cala del Porto AO Apr 21
offer_address: Via Cala del Pozzo, 58043 Punta Ala, Castiglione Della Pescaia GR, Italy

title: Boutique Tuscan Countryside Self-Contained Villas with Welcome Drink & Local Olive Oil
description: Escape to dreamy Tuscany to find a hedonistic haven in a Borgo 69 self-contained villa, an exclusive escape nestled among verdant rolling hills of the Italian countryside. Bask in the boundless vineyards, thriving olive groves and charming hilltop towns from the comfort of the resort’s shimmering infinity pool,  and taste the region with delicious farm-to-table dishes at Emporio di Ines, which uses fresh produce from the property’s magnificent gardens. Chat to the friendly concierge to organise enriching experiences like cycling tours, wine tastings and truffle hunting, all designed to truly experience the top-notch Tuscan treatment.
offer_address: Via Ponte al Ramo, 69, 52045 Pozzo della Chiana AR, Italy

title: Charming Tuscany Wine Country Escape with Daily Breakfast
description:
Among the romantic rolling hills of Tuscany, you'll find the charming 18th-century Relais Villa Grazianella, standing solitary and proud amid a patchwork of vineyards and neat rows of cypress trees. A short distance from Montepulciano, this picturesque region is renowned for its great wine, ornate Renaissance architecture and rustic Italian fare.

Elegant rooms and suites all boast breathtaking views out to the vineyards and distant mountains, while interiors pay tribute to traditional Tuscan design without forgoing modern comforts. Dine in the garden or inside the villa’s restaurant, where typical Tuscan dishes are served with local wines. Take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool, set amid lush gardens and silvery olive trees. The best part? You can taste the rich history of the region at the onsite wine cellar and tasting room, showcasing the territory's significant red wines, from aromatic chianti to sweet Vin Santo.

- Wake up to delicious **daily breakfast**

- Take a journey through Tuscan cuisine with a **tasting menu dinner for two** (for stays of 7+ nights)

**Suite Upgrade:** For an indulgent Tuscan stay, upgrade to a spacious Suite with a jacuzzi bathtub, lounge area with fireplace and plush four-poster king bed.
offer_address: Via Grazianella, 5, 53045 Acquaviva SI, Italy

title: Tuscany Hilltop Castle Luxury with Daily Breakfast & Spa Credit
description:
Fall in love with the soul-stirring beauty of Tuscany from Castello di Velona Resort, Thermal Spa & Winery, a renovated 11th-century fortress perched on a hilltop overlooking the verdant olive groves and vineyards of Val d'Orcia, a 15-minute drive from Montalcino. Part of the prestigious Leading Hotels of the World collection, this luxurious heritage property offers the chance to immerse yourself in the dolce vita lifestyle, indulge in Italian cuisine at nearby Michelin-starred restaurants and discover the charming cities and towns of the Tuscany region.

This stunning property offers a collection of unique rooms that perfectly fuse historic architecture with contemporary touches. Indulge at three onsite eateries, treat yourself at the OLISPA wellness oasis, work out at the fitness centre, sample the wines and olive oil of the estate and vineyard, and relax at the vast thermal pool complex, boasting indoor and outdoor facilities overlooking the surrounding countryside and vineyards.

**Luxury Escapes inclusions (select packages/nights):**

- Start each morning with a delightful **daily breakfast**
- Celebrate your stay with a **welcome drink on arrival**
- Indulge with **EUR50 spa credit** per person, per stay
- **Complimentary room upgrade**, subject to availability (excludes Suites)
- Treat yourself with **EUR75 dining credit** per person, per stay (for stays of 5+ nights)
- Prolong your relaxing escape with **4pm late checkout**, subject to availability (for stays of 5+ nights)

**Looking for added luxury?** Upgrade to a beautiful Suite in the historic part of the castle, with exposed beams, a separate living area and luxe marble bathroom.
location_description: Castello di Velona Resort, Thermal Spa & Winery
offer_address: Strada Provinciale della Badia di Sant'Antimo, 53024 Castelnuovo dell'Abate SI, Italy

title: Romantic Tuscany Escape with Private Olive Grove, Outdoor Pool & Tennis Courts
description: Picturesque valley views and historic country charm are just the beginning of the romantically luxurious offerings at Fontelunga Hotel & Villas. Stroll across pristine gardens, past the private olive groves, with your loved one or take a bike ride through the lush wilderness surrounding this breathtaking, centuries-old property. Dive deep into a moment of relaxation with a dip in the sparkling outdoor pool or enjoy a friendly hit of tennis as the sun sets.
offer_address: Via Cunicchio N5, Foiano della Chiana, 52045 Arezzo, Italy

title: Five-Star Tuscany Escape Just One Hour from Pisa with World-Class Spa & 27-Hole Golf Course
description:
If you’re looking for an authentic Italian experience in the Tuscan countryside, then this secluded haven - just an hour outside of Pisa and Lucca - may be the perfect place for you to taste la dolce vita. Surrounded by thick olive groves, vineyard-cloaked valleys and lush hills, the stunning Toscana Resort Castelfalfi is the perfect base to fall in love with all provincial Italy has to offer.

A one-of-a-kind showcase of the Italian lifestyle, the sprawling resort is complete with a long list of five-star facilities. Wine and dine on authentic cuisine across six gourmet restaurants and bars, tee-off on the 27-hole golf course, take a dip in the heated indoor and outdoor swimming pools and unwind at a blissful spa self-proclaimed to be 'Tuscany's best spa' with a Finnish sauna, Turkish bath and sensory showers. Plus, this retreat is home to its very own olive oil and wine estate and boasts numerous activities to help you embrace the Italian culture, including cooking classes and truffle hunting (charges apply). When the time comes to leave your luxe hideaway, you could visit the beautiful cities of Pisa, the ‘cradle of the Renaissance’ Florence, San Gimignano and Volterra.

offer_address: Località Castelfalfi, 50050 Montaione, FI, Italy

title: Convenient Coolangatta Apartment Escape Moments from the Beach with Two Pools & Tennis Courts
description:
Discover a world of coastal bliss in Coolangatta with a stylish stay in Gold Coast's most southerly tip, situated moments from the surf-friendly shores of Coolangatta Beach. Take a dip in the property's heated indoor and outdoor pools, tee off at the mini golf course and serve and volley it up at the tennis courts.

After a day of exploring the scenic Marine Parade, visiting Greenmount Beach and Rainbow Bay, retreat to your spacious room or apartment, imbued with all modern amenities. The adjacent Twin Towns Services Club is home to a number of restaurants for all your culinary needs, or you can take advantage of the on-site BBQ facilities to whip up a feast of your own.

title: Ubud Pool Villa Oasis near Heritage-Listed Rice Terraces with Jungle Views
description:
Run away to the misty hills of Ubud and relax like never before in your private villa among the verdant jungle. Spend your days exploring the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Tegallalang Rice Terraces, savour bold Balinese flavours at the bustling Ubud Market or find inner peace at the sacred Tirta Empul Temple.

With two- and three-bedroom villa variations to choose from, the whole family can enjoy quality time at Khastana Hadi Resort Ubud. Luxuriate in your private pool amid stunning jungle surroudnings, or rejuvenate your senses with indulgent in-villa massages. description:
Discover the lush jungles, temples and art markets of Ubud when you stay at Asvara Villa Ubud, a romantic all-villa hideaway surrounded by evergreen rice fields. It's all too easy to forget about the rest of the world in your own private villa, complete with a private swimming pool, bubbling jacuzzi, kitchenette and breezy lounge.

title: Five-Star Award-Winning Ubud Suites near Bali's Rice Paddies
description: Escape to the undulating hills of Ubud in search of serenity and rejuvenation at the five-star Tanah Gajah, a Resort by Hadiprana. This luxury retreat is home to just twenty suites and villas, each featuring unique artwork, traditional elegance and modern-day comforts in natural Balinese surrounds. Hidden within 12 acres of verdant emerald rice paddies, this heavenly resort radiates peace, quiet and tranquility, but is just ten minutes from the artists' village of Ubud. Unwind with a day of pampering at the spa, indulge in a romantic feast amidst the rice paddies, or witness the beauty of the region from above with Bali’s first hot-ballooning adventure.

description: Escape to a five-star oasis perched above the Ayung River at Nandini Jungle by Hanging Gardens, a serene destination located in the heart of the Payangan Rainforest. After busy days exploring the bustling vibrance of Ubud or traversing through the concealed jungle paths, retreat to this intimate haven to enjoy a luxurious massage, practice yoga or simply relax around the outdoor swimming pool. As the sun sets, head to Wild Ginger Restaurant to enjoy the traditional culinary delights on offer.

title: Five-Star Award-Winning Ubud Jungle Wellness Sanctuary on the Ayung River
description: Let the rest of the world melt away when you succumb to bliss at COMO Shambhala Estate, an award-winning wellness sanctuary resting on the banks of the Ayung River, just outside of Ubud. At its heart, the resort is dedicated to achieving balance through holistic means. World-class facilities include nine treatment rooms and three treatment pavilions, each with verdant jungle panoramas, plus an outdoor vitality pool for hydrotherapy and a top-of-the-range yoga pavilion. To complement your well-being journey, indulge in nutritious and seasonal dishes at Glow, where you can watch your food being prepared in the open kitchen. Meanwhile, Indonesia's complex flavours and spices await at Kudus House, housed within a 150-year-old former Javanese residence.
offer_opportunity_name: COMO Shambhala Estate - COMO - Ultra Lux
offer_address: Banjar Begawan, Desa, Melinggih Kelod, Kec. Payangan, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia

title: Multi-Award-Winning Five-Star Ubud Sanctuary Perched Above Petanu River Gorge
description:
Discover a New Type of Tropical Paradise at Viceroy Bali. Viceroy Bali is a five-star sanctuary nestled in a steep ravine overlooking the tranquil Petanu Valley, part of the exclusive Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH) Finest Collections. Sitting on a steep ravine, overlooking the Petanu Valley, this luxury hotel is surrounded by rich Balinese jungle but is just five minutes from the centre of bustling Ubud. Here, you’ll find some of the island’s best restaurants, magnificent markets and independent boutiques, full of unique artisan gifts.

Intimate and family-run (a true rarity for a five-star hotel in Bali), Viceroy Bali is home to 40 suites and villas, each with thatched roofs, sweeping views of perfectly placed palm trees, private pools and luxurious amenities. The list of awards is lengthy and includes accolades from the Small Luxury Hotels of the World Awards and Galatian Signature Hotels Awards for 2020 alone. While leaving your sumptuous sanctuary is optional, there’s more to explore. Discover true tranquility at Akoya Spa, where treatments combine traditional Balinese techniques with modern wellness knowledge. 

Delight in the finest dining at Apéritif Restaurant, an elegant 1920s-inspired venue serving a distinguished degustation menu that celebrates high-quality ingredients and offering a borderless food experience that transcends traditional culinary boundaries. For a more laid-back experience, CasCades Restaurant presents a delicious selection of traditional Indonesian dishes alongside Western classics, all set in a stunning environment. For those seeking a sophisticated yet relaxed atmosphere, Pinstripe Bar offers expertly crafted cocktails, fine spirits, and an ambiance that perfectly complements the vibrant energy of Ubud.
offer_address: Jl. Lanyahan, Br. Nagi, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia

title: Serene Five-Star Ubud Retreat
description:
Indulge in the ultimate feeling of five-star bliss at the breathtaking Maya Ubud Resort & Spa - a stunning Balinese sanctuary that offers guests complete serenity. Cradled by the dramatic Petanu River valley and the rolling rice paddies of Peliatan, Maya Ubud is a jewel within a tranquil 10-hectare tropical haven. From here, it's a leisurely 25-minute stroll to vibrant Ubud town, bursting with artisan markets, colourful boutiques and world-class restaurants.

Designed to capture the spirit of a traditional Balinese village, this ultra-luxe retreat combines local elegance and hospitality with a true five-star experience. Reconnect with nature and plunge into the glistening infinity pool overlooking the enchanting forest, experience euphoria at Maya Spa with a rejuvenating treatment beside the swirling waters of Petanu River, or spend each morning aligning your chakras at the tranquil Bale Raga Yoga Studio. Live the good life in a carefully designed suite or villa, beautiful spaces bathed in natural light and boasting verdant vistas across the lush surrounds.
offer_opportunity_name: Maya Ubud Resort & Spa LPC Sep 20
offer_address: Jalan Gunung Sari, Banjar Ambengan, Desa Peliatan, Ubud, Kec. Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia Gianyar 80571 Indonesia

title: Unique Capella Ubud Luxury Tents in the Lush Rainforest with Private Pools
description:
Where natural wonder meets boutique luxury completely surrounded by the beauty of Ubud's rainforest, Capella Ubud, Bali is the serene sanctuary crowned 'Best Upcountry Hotel' in Travel + Leisure's Luxury Awards Asia Pacific 2023. This exclusive retreat spans a collection of heritage-inspired tents and one lodge, all with private pools, that weave together to form an opulent camp rich with decor inspired by Bali's past. Savor culinary delights at Mads Lange, as you join in paying homage to the famed Danish spice trader, and Api Jiwa, where bold flavours inspired by Asian omakase dance on your palate. Toast with craft cocktails at The Mortar and Pestle Bar while munching on light snacks and listening to the sweet sounds of the forest.

Relax in the Officer's Tent, exclusively for camp residents, or gather around the campfire for storytelling evenings under the twinkling sky. Stay active throughout your stay at The Armory, the camp's tented gymnasium, offering state-of-the-art equipment and guided wellness activities from yoga to village biking. The site’s 120sqm outdoor rainforest pool invites you to swim amidst nature's beauty and Capella’s day spa, Auriga Wellness, takes you on a journey of pampering and spiritual healing.
offer_address: Jl. Raya Dalem, Banjar Triwangsa Desa Keliki, Kecamatan Tegallalang, 80561 Ubud, Bali, Indonesia

title: Romantic Ubud Jungle Paradise with Infinity Pool
description: Discover a new level of romantic luxury at Aksari Resort Ubud, a contemporary collection of suites and villas nestled in the lush valleys of Bali's Ubud. Take a dip in the cascading infinity pool perched over the jungle, recharge your body and mind with a decadent massage or spa treatment at Svaha Spa and dive into authentic Indonesian cuisine at Ankhusa or Japanese delicacies at Kojin Teppanyaki Restaurant.
location_description: Aksari Luxury Resort & Spa Ubud by Ini Vie Hospitality
offer_address: 88 Jalan Raya Desa Kenderan, Kenderan, Ubud, Bali 80561, Indonesia

title: Ubud Five-Star Jungle Haven with Italian-Inspired Dining
description: Allow the artful spirit of Ubud to take hold when you stay at the five-star COMO Uma Ubud, a jungle sanctuary enveloped by coconut palms and banyan trees on the cusp of the Tjampuhan Valley. The outdoor terrace is the perfect place to catch balmy breezes and at the celebrated Uma Cucina, an Italian-inspired restaurant and lounge bar serving antipasto platters or ribbons of silky pasta alongside innovative cocktails from a menu curated by Lewis Wilkinson, a leading London mixologist. Slip into total bliss at the top-rated wellness centre, a tranquil haven with decadent spa treatments including a soothing Indonesian massage, plus a yoga pavilion and a 25-metre swimming pool.
offer_opportunity_name: COMO Uma Ubud - COMO Ultra Lux #6
offer_address: Jalan Raya Sanggingan, Banjar Lungsiakan, Kedawatan, Ubud, Gianyar 80571, Bali, Indonesia

title: Idyllic Five-Star Villa Sanctuary in the Heart of Ubud with Private Pools & Onsite Spa
description: A collection of impeccably designed villas set deep in the heart of Ubud’s lush rainforest and verdant rice paddies, five-star Bali relaxation awaits at The Samanya Ubud Bali. Feel at peace as you arrive on the tranquil grounds and make your way to your private, incredibly spacious villa. Relieve any lingering tension with a rejuvenating trip to the resort’s spa, and leave the gastronomy and mixology to the professionals with a feast at either Swept Away or Scene restaurant.
offer_address: Jalan Banjar Baung, Desa Sayan, Ubud, Bali 80571, Indonesia

title: Serene Five-Star Ubud Sanctuary near Bali Zoo
description:
Indulge in five-star jungle bliss at Sanctoo Suites & Villas, a secluded and serene sanctuary nestled in the heart of Ubud. Sitting in the town of Singapadu, just 30 minutes from the centre of Ubud, this peaceful patch is inspired by its proximity to the award-winning and internationally accredited Bali Zoo, with a prime position overlooking the Savannah exhibit, home to exotic African wildlife. A complimentary shuttle to the town centre puts you in the middle of the cultural action, with world-class restaurants, beautiful boutiques and great galleries all within easy reach.

Revive your senses at Sanctoo Spa, where trained therapists offer body scrubs and signature massages, or spend hours soaking up the sunshine by the savannah-inspired pool. Explore the surrounding rice paddies with a local guide or take on a two-wheel journey, mountain-biking through local villages for a taste of traditional life. Say hello to the orangutans at Kampung Sumatra, or get up close and personal with a raft of local and international animals that call Bali Zoo home. At the end of the day, rely on Sanctoo Restaurant for sensational sustenance - the menu celebrates local and international flavours, with traditional Balinese dishes enjoyed alongside Western classics.
offer_address: Raya 80582, Indonesia, Jl. Ulun Suwi 2, Singapadu, Kec. Sukawati, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80582, Indonesia

title: Tranquil Five-Star Ubud Retreat near Bali Zoo
description: Indulge in five-star jungle bliss at Sanctoo Suites & Villas, a serene sanctuary tucked away in the region of Gianyar, adjacent to Bali Zoo and around 20 minutes from Ubud's centre. This peaceful patch is inspired by its locale, with a lagoon pool that mimics the natural water holes of the African savannah and tranquil vistas over Wos River. Revive your senses at Sanctoo Spa with a hot stone massage or organic facial, or visit Sanctoo Restaurant for wholesome Balinese dishes.
offer_opportunity_name: Sanctoo Suites & Villas - LPC (New Rate Dock Opp)

title: Five-Star Alila Ubud Jungle Hideaway with World-Famous Infinity Pool
description: Discover the epitome of jungle bliss with a five-star escape to Alila Ubud, nestled high above the Ayung River Valley, sprawled across the hillside among world-famous rice paddies. This serene jungle hideaway offers the utmost in luxury and seclusion, only around 15 minutes from Ubud's centre. Savour authentic farm-to-table Balinese cuisine and Western classics at Plantation Restaurant, enjoy age-old beauty treatments at Spa Alila or opt to simply relax by the world-famous infinity pool - recognised by Vogue Australia as one of the most beautiful in Bali.
offer_address: Desa Melinggih Kelod, Payangan, Gianyar, Bali 80572, Indonesia

title: Boutique Ubud Eco-Luxury Jungle Retreat with Natural Pools & Rejuvenating Spa
description:
Immerse yourself in the tranquillity of a Balinese jungle and be in harmony with nature at this luxurious sustainable stay, cradled in the heart of Ubud and perched by a babbling river. Rejuvenate amid the rich forest foliage, breathe in the crisp air, take a refreshing dip in the spring-fed natural pools and pamper yourself with authentic Balinese treatments in the stunning massage pods.

Boasting uniquely curated organic bamboo houses, choose to stay high up in the treetops or by the river and indulge in unparalleled luxury. Tuck into farm-to-table delights and Balinese delicacies at the picturesque The Riverside Warung, and sip on fruity cocktails at The Elevator Sunset Bar. If you wish to explore, there are plenty of hiking trails and walking tours to embark on nearby, while Ubud's cultural icons are only moments away.

title: Romantic Ubud Suite Escape with Infinity Pool

Absorb the beauty of the terraced rice paddies and breathtaking valleys from the resort's stunning infinity pool, complete with an oversized hammock swaying at its edge. Tap into your spiritual side with daily yoga sessions or be pampered at Svaha Spa. Later, be sure to refuel at Habitat Bistro, where signature local and international dishes await.

title: Five-Star Bali Retreat just 10 Minutes from Ubud with Rooftop Bar
description: Discover romance among rivers and rice fields with a five-star stay at Tanadewa Resort and Spa - Ubud by Cross Collection, just 10 minutes from Bali’s soulful centre. Wake each morning to spectacular panoramic views of the lush jungle and savour days enriched by the resort’s effortless serenity. Sip cocktails high above Ubud at the stylish Sky Terrace, head to Tanaspa for traditional treatments surrounded by verdant green or watch the river drift lazily by from the resort’s infinity pool.
offer_opportunity_name: Tanadewa Resort and Spa - Ubud LPC 2022
