title: Ubud Adults-Only Serene Escape with Rice Field Views & Spa
description:
This adults-only sanctuary, tucked away amongst Ubud's lush rice fields, offers a serene escape surrounded by idyllic greenery and breathtaking views of the majestic Mount Agung. Whether it's waking to a gentle sunrise over the rice fields from your bamboo villa, relaxing by the tranquil lagoon-style pool, or rejuvenating your body at Lasati Spa, Beehouse Dijiwa Ubud invites guests to unwind in a setting that celebrates Bali’s rich culture and natural beauty.

Designed like bee houses with structures made of wood and bamboo, this haven of tranquillity pays homage to traditional Balinese craftsmanship. When you're not soaking up pure bliss in your villa, embark on a cycling tour through Peliatan Village or enjoy a guided tour through the rice paddies. This is a place to rediscover simplicity, find inner peace and connect with the soul of Bali.

title: Five-Star Elegant Beachfront Resort near Ubud with Daily Breakfast
description:
Transport yourself to a state of pure bliss with a stay at the beachfront Rumah Luwih, Bali - a five-star waterfront hideaway just a short distance from Sanur and Ubud. Styled after a classic colonial Indonesian mansion, Rumah Luwih offers pure elegance in the tranquil province of Gianyar, renowned for its outstanding food and popular night market.

description:
Indulge in extravagantly elegant five-star luxury at Baur au Lac, recognised as the #1 Hotel in the World at the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2020. The grand dame of Zürich's hospitality scene, this outstanding property has been operating since 1844 under the same family and is situated in expansive private parkland with jaw-dropping views of Lake Zürich and the surrounding Swiss Alps. Despite its serene setting, it couldn’t be closer to the action - Zürich's iconic shopping strip, Bahnhofstrasse, is just metres away, while famous Old Town landmarks require a 10-minute stroll.

With so much on offer at Baur au Lac, leaving its extensive grounds may not be necessary. The old-world grandeur of its design is visible across every floor, with Art Deco, Louis XVI and English regency touches intermingling with jewel colours and gorgeous flowers, thanks to the in-house florist. Discover the skill and sorcery of Head Chef Laurent Eperon at the two-Michelin-starred Pavillon, or visit Baur, where the classic brasserie concept is elevated to deliver a mouthwatering seasonal menu. Spend an afternoon at Le Hall for tea and macarons or, over summer, venture to Baur au Lac Terrasse for snacks and refreshing drinks. A rooftop fitness centre makes breaking a sweat seamless, with massages available to relieve sore muscles.
offer_address: Talstrasse 1, 8001 Zürich, Switzerland

title: Ultimate Hua Hin Secluded Luxury Near Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park with Onsite Spa
description:
Unwind in the lap of sophistication at the Aleenta property that started it all - the five-star Aleenta Hua Hin - Pranburi Resort & Spa, part of the acclaimed Small Luxury Hotels of the World collection. Nestled in captivating Paknampran Bay, close to Hua Hin town and just 40 minutes from the soaring limestone mountains, otherworldly caves and champagne beaches of Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park, this resort is the ultimate secluded escape overlooking the Gulf of Thailand.

Tucked away within Thailand’s historical royal seaside retreat, Hua Hin, and home to just 25 impeccable residences - some just steps from the crystal-clear ocean and others with private plunge pools - this boutique resort is nothing short of spectacular. Let this exquisite hideaway lure you in with an extensive menu of wellness treatments at Ayurah Spa, including nourishing mud treatments, body polishes, therapeutic massages and more. As part of the Ayurah Wellness retreat offerings guests can enjoy complimentary wellness classes along with personalised exercise programs led by trainers.

title: Top-Rated Sea-View Croatia Escape with Spa Credit & Daily Breakfast
description:
The unforgettable Adriatic awaits with a breathtaking stay at Croatia’s D-Resort Šibenik, set next to the city's spectacular yacht marina. Surrounded by the sea on three sides, the grandeur of this property has earned it a place in the prestigious Small Luxury Hotels of the World collection and a Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice 2020 award. Designed by famed architect Nikola Bašić, known for Zadar's 'Sea Organ’ installation, this unique hotel gives the feeling of being aboard a large, modern ship, with all rooms enjoying sweeping views across the azure waters of the medieval port. The resort’s contemporary design respectfully blends the striking, light-filled concrete interior with dramatic exterior curves that reflect the glamorous marina setting below, adding excitement to the landscape of this historic spot.

Šibenik is a city on the Adriatic coast of Croatia and a quieter alternative to popular tourist hotspots such as Dubrovnik and Split. It's renowned for its spectacular history, including the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Catherdal of St. James, adorned with 74 striking depictions of local luminaries. The city museum delves deeper into the area's history and is a must for visitors to Šibenik. With a collection of spacious rooms, villas and suites, luxurious facilities - including an outdoor infinity pool, restaurant and four bars, kids’ club and luxury wellness and spa area - this spectacular resort is a secret you'll want to keep to yourself.
